mapper.select: SELECT project_key, cyclomatic_complexity, cognitive_complexity, duplicate_ratio, minimum_duplicate_lines FROM source_quality_threshold WHERE project_key = #{projectKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO source_quality_threshold ( project_key, cyclomatic_complexity, cognitive_complexity, duplicate_ratio, minimum_duplicate_lines, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{projectKey}, #{cyclomaticComplexity}, #{cognitiveComplexity}, #{duplicateRatio}, #{minimumDuplicateLines}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (project_key) DO UPDATE SET cyclomatic_complexity = EXCLUDED.cyclomatic_complexity, cognitive_complexity = EXCLUDED.cognitive_complexity, duplicate_ratio = EXCLUDED.duplicate_ratio, minimum_duplicate_lines = EXCLUDED.minimum_duplicate_lines, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.sql: id, project_key, total_method_count, duplicate_method_count, duplicate_group_count, duplicate_ratio, high_complexity_count, max_cyclomatic_complexity, max_cognitive_complexity, gate_status, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM source_quality_snapshot WHERE project_key = #{projectKey} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
